{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check that deduplication reduced the row count by 24 (since 24 patients were retested)
assert len(df_dedup) == len(df) - 24, "Deduplication did not reduce row count by 24"

# Compute the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
total_patients = len(df_dedup)
severe_patients = df_dedup['severity'].eq('severe').sum()
fraction_severe = severe_patients / total_patients

print(f"Total patients after deduplication: {total_patients}")
print(f"Number with severe baseline: {severe_patients}")
print(f"Fraction with severe baseline: {fraction_severe}")"}
